title_sq: Ne Vasil Shanto, Shitet Apartament 2+1 Me Verande!!!
description_sq: Tek zona e Vasil Shantos, prapa Kesh-it, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 i Mobiluar!!! Ne nje nga zonat me te mira ne Tirane, shitet apartament 2+1, ne katin e pare te nje pallati ekzistues. Apartamenti ka siperfaqe bruto 130 m2 dhe siperfaqe neto 114 m2 ne certifikate dhe eshte i organizuar ne korridor te bollshem qe ben shperndarjen neper ambientet e tjera, ne ambientin e ndenjes, se bashku me kuzhinen e gatimit dhe me dalje ne verande, dy dhoma gjumi nga e cila njera eshte me tualet te dedikuar, me dritare, nje tualet tjeter po me dritare, nje dhome me vete per Lavanteri, nje depo si dhe veranda me siperfaqe 30 m2 ne proces legalizimi. Apartamenti disponon dhe nje bodrum ne katin -1. Orientohet nga Veri-Perendimi-Jug. Apartamenti eshte i investuar nga pronari duke filluar nga sistemi elektrik, sistemi hidraulik, tualeti, parketi, dritare dopio xham, etj.Zona ne te cilen ndodhet eshte nder me te mirat ne Tirane per shkak se ka afer cdo facilitet te mundshem, shkolla, kopshte, linja urbane, etj. dhe shume afer qendres qe te krijon mundesine per nje jetese cilesore. Apartamenti eshte nje mundesi shume e mire per banim por edhe per investim duke qene se qirate ne ate zone jane te shtrenjta. Aktualisht apartamenti eshte i dhene me qira ne vleren 800 euro/muaj.
title_en: In Vasil Shanto, 2+1 apartment with veranda for sale!!!
description_en: In Vasil Shanto area, behind Kesh, 2+1+2 Furnished Apartment for sale!!! In one of the best areas in Tirana, a 2+1 apartment is for sale, on the first floor of an existing building. The apartment has a gross area of 130 m2 and a net area of 114 m2 in the certificate and is organized in a spacious corridor that distributes it to the other rooms, in the living room, together with the cooking kitchen and exit to the veranda, two bedrooms, one of which has a dedicated toilet, with a window, another toilet with a window, a separate room for the laundry, a storage room and veranda with a surface of 30 m2 in the process of legalization. The apartment also has a basement on the -1st floor. It is oriented from North-West-South. The apartment is invested by the owner, starting with the electrical system, plumbing system, toilet, parquet, double-glazed windows, etc. The area in which it is located is one of the best in Tirana because it is close to every possible facility, schools, kindergartens, urban lines, etc. and very close to the center to create the opportunity for a quality life. The apartment is a very good opportunity for housing but also for investment, since rents in that area are expensive. Currently, the apartment is rented for 800 euros/month.
